title: 第1930章 陈稳的选择你选的是绝路第1929章 吓了一大跳进入秘境
slug: 被问罪当天无上帝族杀来
content_zh:
第1930章陈稳的选择，你选的是绝路
但很快，他便又压下了心头的怒火。
眼下的情况，如果他失态了，那一定会非常难看。
但他会用实力来打牧晴的脸。
念及此，萧不易才朝着诸葛伏天所在走去。
诸葛伏天见回来的两人，不由开口道，“怎么样，有没有收获？”
牧晴深吸了一口气，然后开口道，“我确实是有一些想法，但并不能百分百确定。”
“哦，说出来看看。”
诸葛伏天看了牧晴一眼，然后道。
牧晴点了点头，“我用地灵术探寻找的方向是东南方。”
“我认为我们可以往这个方向走，应该不会遇到什么大危险。”
“应该？”
还不待诸葛伏天有所反应，萧不易便冷嘲了起来。
下一刻，他又开口道，“我们这里的五十九条人命，是你一句应该能承担得起的？”
此话一出，众人的眼底不由一闪。
确实如此。
如果仅仅是一句应该，他们不敢完全信服。
因为那与拿着自己的命去赌，没有太大的差别了。
而像他们这种地位的人，怎么可能去赌命。
对此，牧晴并没有反驳。

因为这就是她内心最真实的想法。
能探出一条路来，已经是她的极限了。
至于这条路有多少危险，危险又是什么，她真的不敢下断言。
因为她知道这不是一句话的事，而是沉甸甸的责任。
诸葛伏天看了牧晴一眼，然后道，“你有什么说的？”
“无话可说。”牧晴深吸了一口气。
也不过如此。
萧不易不屑地撇了撇嘴。
她还以当牧晴会与他争论一番呢，没想到差远了。
诸葛伏天没有再多说什么，而是转头看向萧不易，“那你看出来什么了？”
萧不易很是自信地道，“我探出来的是西北方向。”
“我可以向所有人保证，这绝对是一条安全且充满机遇的道路。”
“如果各位长老和同门，愿意相信我萧不易。”
“那我必带大家走出这个鬼地方，奔向更好的未来。”
此话一出，众人便都沉默了下来，但神色在变幻不止。
content_en:
Chapter 1930 Chen Wen’s choice, you chose a dead end
But soon, he suppressed the anger in his heart.
In the current situation, if he loses his composure, it will definitely be very ugly.
But he will use his strength to hit Mu Qing in the face.
Thinking of this, Xiao Buyi walked towards where Zhuge Futian was.
When Zhuge Futian saw the two people returning, he couldn't help but said, "How is it? Have you gained anything?"
Mu Qing took a deep breath and then said, "I do have some ideas, but I'm not 100% sure."
"Oh, tell me."
Zhuge Futian glanced at Mu Qing and then said.
Mu Qing nodded, "The direction I'm looking for using Earth Spirit Technique is the southeast."
"I think we can go in this direction without encountering any big danger."
"Should?"
Before Zhuge Futian could react, Xiao Buyi started to sneer.
The next moment, he spoke again, "Are you able to afford the fifty-nine lives we have here?"
As soon as these words came out, everyone's eyes couldn't help but flash.
Indeed.
If it's just a "should", they won't be completely convinced.
Because there is not much difference between that and gambling with one's own life.
How could people of their status risk their lives?
Mu Qing did not refute this.
Because this is the truest thought in her heart.
It was her limit to be able to find a way out.
As for how dangerous this road was and what the dangers were, she really didn't dare to make a conclusion.
Because she knows that this is not a matter of words, but a heavy responsibility.
Zhuge Futian glanced at Mu Qing, and then said, "What do you have to say?"
"Nothing to say." Mu Qing took a deep breath.
Nothing more than that.
Xiao Buyi curled his lips disdainfully.
She thought Mu Qing would argue with him, but she didn't expect it to be far off.
Zhuge Futian didn't say anything more, but turned to look at Xiao Buyi, "Then what did you see?"
Xiao Buyi said confidently, "What I found is the northwest direction."
"I can assure everyone that this is a path that is safe and full of opportunity."
"If all the elders and fellow disciples are willing to believe in me, Xiao Buyi."
"Then I will take everyone out of this hellish place and towards a better future."
As soon as these words came out, everyone fell silent, but their expressions kept changing.
